contentPattern.structure: full-bleed background photograph + left-aligned translucent white panel (eyebrow + heading + supporting line + single download CTA)

suitableFor: content / reporting page heros with a single background photograph
pages leading with a downloadable-resource CTA (PDF report) over an image
left-overlay text-panel heros on a full-bleed photo
notSuitableFor: heros with a looping background video (use hero-video / hero-stats)
dark full-bleed video heros with a stats strip (use hero-stats)
light two-column text-beside-media heros with an overlaid stats bar (use hero-impact)
